verdict.rationale: Deel is a payroll platform, so off-cycle payroll is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence only shows generic claims about running compliant payroll across 150+ countries. Nothing documents an off-cycle run for bonuses, corrections, or terminations outside the regular schedule.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run an off-cycle payroll for bonuses, corrections, or terminations outside the regular schedule
